source: end-to-end scene (tube variant), recorded state with the eyelet clamped above the cassette

parts.title: The workcell
parts.role: A five-axis gantry robot that picks a thread, carries it to a tissue phantom and inserts it.
parts.specs: Deck 658 × 448 mm. Simulated in MuJoCo; this view is the end-to-end scene.

parts.title: Base and deck
parts.role: The rigid table everything mounts to. Disturbance models treat it as an isolation table that can still vibrate.
parts.specs: Nominal table vibration 1 mm/s² per component, 5–60 Hz.

parts.title: Gantry frame
parts.role: Two towers and a beam carry the X rail high above the work area.
parts.specs: Beam centre 465 mm above the deck.

parts.title: X stage
parts.role: Carriage running along the beam: moves the whole tool left and right.
parts.specs: Travel ±175 mm · moving mass 2.4 kg · force limit 100 N.

parts.title: Y stage
parts.role: Boom hanging from the X carriage: moves the tool toward and away from the viewer.

parts.title: Z stage (tool head)
parts.role: Raises and lowers the whole tool head; it lifts the 44 mm thread clear during transport.

parts.title: Microscope
parts.role: Optical head beside the needle with an oblique view of the work point. In these experiments its camera is for observers only; the controllers do not use pixels.

parts.title: Needle carriage
parts.role: Fine vertical slide that drives the needle; it supplies the last millimetres down to the tissue and the insertion stroke.

parts.title: Needle with slotted tip
parts.role: A 150 µm needle. Two small lips near the tip form a side slot that captures the thread's eyelet rim: lifting carries it up, inserting pushes it down, sliding sideways releases it.
parts.specs: Ø 150 µm · lips 40 µm wire reaching 200 µm · slot opening 140 µm.

parts.title: Keeper
parts.role: Rides on the needle carriage. During transport two prongs lower beside the slot and their pads clamp the eyelet rim onto the slot's lower lip; it lifts away before insertion.
parts.specs: Travel 0–6 mm · prongs and pads 40 µm wire · clamp about 1 mN.

parts.title: Thread
parts.role: The implant: a flexible 40 µm thread simulated as a discrete elastic rod, so it bends, drapes and snags like a real filament.
parts.specs: Ø 40 µm · 44 mm · 32 segments · illustrative 100 MPa material. Shown up close: at the scale of the machine it is thinner than a pixel.

parts.title: Eyelet
parts.role: A small rigid ring on the thread's free end, the handle the needle picks up and pushes into tissue.
parts.specs: Ring radius 180 µm · wire Ø 40 µm.

parts.title: Thread cassette
parts.role: Presents threads for pickup. A shallow trench under each eyelet lets the needle's lower lip pass beneath the rim.

parts.title: Specimen support
parts.role: Tray and clamps that hold the tissue phantom still on the deck.

parts.title: Tissue phantom
parts.role: A domed block standing in for tissue. Its surface is a real collision surface for the robot and the thread.

parts.title: Target sites
parts.role: Six marked insertion sites. Alignment learns to bring the needle 1 mm above any of them within 10 µm.
parts.specs: Six sites, ring markers 2.5 mm across (markings, no collision).

parts.title: Vessels
parts.role: Blood-vessel markings on the surface. The robot must not pass low over them; they are markings, scored by the task, not obstacles.
parts.specs: Main vessel Ø 1 mm, branches Ø 0.56 mm.

parts.title: Insertion tube
parts.role: A pre-formed tube at the target with real collision: it guides the needle and holds the thread by contact. Used in the end-to-end cycle instead of a puncture model.
parts.specs: Bore radius 0.28 mm · 3 mm deep · skin around the opening.
